profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Oracle
profile.summary:
9+ years as a Software Test Engineer. Self motivated problem solver. Fast learner.
IO (NIC, SCSI, SAS, IB, NVMe) Test Lead who designs, implements and automates test plans, test specifications and test cases.

Technical Specialties :
Programming : Proficient in C, Perl ; Experienced in Python, Shell Programming, C++, Assembly, Javascript, SQL, R
Platforms : Linux, Unix, Windows
Networking : Cisco Routers and Switches

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: Focus on NIC Networking on the AMD platform. Work on TCP/IP and RoCE. Work in both PF and VF of the NIC devices. Machines used in VMs, Big Data and Block and Object Storages.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Qualify enterprise servers and IO PCIe cards (NIC, SAS, SCSI, IB, NVMe) functionality and performance 
Test virtualization on the SPARC platforms using LDOMs (Logical Domains). Currently testing virtualization Linux using kvm+QEMU.
Ensure that the OS (Linux/Solaris) is functioning on the  servers.
Run performance measurement tools and ensure that the NIC and HBA cards are running close to line rate.
Contribute success to platforms by designing, implementing and automating test plans and specifications for platforms and option cards
Participate in the active discussion of our automation group. Also participate in code review for the automation written in Python.
Gather customer needs and ensure stability of products before releasing them.
Review issues that customer face and implement new test cases to cover the test escapes
Partner with global development teams to resolve bugs.
Interact with Marketing group to set reachable product goals.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Platform testing on high-end Oracle Solaris Servers. Implement the test requirements, test plans and test specifications. Focus testing on Network Interface Cards and also Storage devices (HBA/SAS) to ensure that the performance is met on the Solaris Servers. Use LDOMS virtualization to assign resources (memory, cpus, IO devices) out to other virtual domains. Perform manual testing and automate the test cases after stability is achieved.

Window of communication with the marketing group on the maximum number of cards that the platform can support.

positions.title: Project Manager
positions.description:
Issue warrants for trading in the market and dynamically hedge the risk by trading underlying stocks.

Trade stocks and futures in the stock and futures market.

Calculate prices for financial products (Equity Linked Notes, Principle Guarantee Notes, Warrants, Convertible Bonds, etc.) and offer our customers reasonable prices.

Design CBAS products for our customers.

Help maintain the CDO portfolio that our company has.

Using a local database, I run a program to pick stocks that has unusual volume in the warrants market.

Design, implement and maintain a profit/loss software system to automatically generate reports for daily, monthly and annual stock trading profit/loss for our department.

Create a software system to assist in the reporting of our daily stock positions the stock exchange.

Automate a software system that updates the daily profit/loss information on our website, enabling our customers could see the information

positions.title: Software Test Engineer
positions.description:
Ensured stability of products (routers and switches) before releasing them to our customers by designing test plans, executing them and automating them.

Partnered with team to verify the scalability, interoperability and reliability of the routers.

Ensured the functionality of the routers using routing protocols like BGP, OSPF and ISIS.

Communicated with customers to improve Cisco’s products.

Worked closely with development teams to solve problems.

Presented to my fellow colleagues on my findings so as to keep everybody updated (either in a presentation or on Video-on-Demand).

Attended meetings and helped to allocate resources for my group in the absence of my manager.

positions.title: Assistant System Administrator
positions.description:
Maintained the local area network within the building.

Determined the cause and fixed network failures.

Maintained an Oracle database that stored company information.

Coordinated meetings between system engineers and end users.

Managed a group of 5 people.

educations.schoolName: Santa Clara University Leavey School of Business
